sections.heading: Introduction
content: The Guardians of the Future are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information in connection with your use of the Guardians of the Future platform (hereafter Platform).
We process personal data in accordance with the UK GDPR, EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and other applicable data protection laws.
By using the Platform, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as described in this Policy.

sections.heading: How We Use Personal Data
content: We use personal data to:

items: Respond to enquiries and support requests
Protect users and maintain platform security

trailingContent: We will not sell, nor will we ever disclose personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Legal Bases for Processing
content: We process personal data under one or more of the following legal bases:

lists.label: Consent
lists.intro: Where you voluntarily provide information or agree to specific processing activities.

lists.label: Legitimate Interests
lists.intro: To operate, improve, and secure the Platform and support volunteer participation.

lists.label: Contractual Necessity
lists.intro: Where processing is necessary to provide services requested by users.

lists.label: Legal Obligations
lists.intro: Where we are required to process data under applicable laws.

sections.heading: Sharing Personal Data
content: We may share information with:

lists.label: Service Providers
lists.intro: Third-party providers that help us operate the Platform, including:

note.text: These providers process data only under our instructions and appropriate contractual safeguards.

lists.label: Legal Authorities
lists.intro: Where required by law, court order, safeguarding obligations, or legitimate protection of rights and safety.

lists.label: Other Users
lists.intro: Certain profile information and participation information may be visible to other users as part of Platform functionality.

sections.heading: International Data Transfers
content: Where personal data is transferred outside the United Kingdom or European Economic Area (EEA), we will ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including:

sections.heading: Data Retention
content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to:

items: Active account data is retained while the account remains active.
Inactive accounts may be deleted after 12 months of inactivity.
Legal and safeguarding records may be retained longer where required.

sections.heading: Data Security
content: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including:

sections.heading: Your GDPR Rights
content: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to:

lists.label: Access
lists.intro: Request a copy of your personal data.

lists.label: Data Portability
lists.intro: Receive your personal data in a structured format.

lists.label: Objection
lists.intro: Object to processing based on legitimate interests.

lists.label: Withdraw Consent
lists.intro: Withdraw consent at any time where processing relies on consent.

trailingContent: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
content: The Platform is intended primarily for adults.
Where minors participate, parental or legal guardian consent may be required in accordance with applicable laws.
We take additional safeguarding measures where children or vulnerable individuals are involved.

sections.heading: Safeguarding and Protection
content: To maintain a safe environment, we may process personal information necessary to:
trailingContent: Such processing will be limited to what is necessary and proportionate.

content: The Platform may use cookies and similar technologies for:
trailingContent: Users may manage cookie preferences through browser settings where applicable.

sections.heading: Complaints
content: If you believe your personal data has been processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
If located within the European Union, you may contact your national Data Protection Authority.
If located in the United Kingdom, complaints may be directed to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

sections.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Any changes will be published on the Platform with an updated revision date.
Continued use of the Platform after publication constitutes acknowledgment of the updated Policy.
